dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: This makes no sense... How did you do that!? My... my reputation is destroyed!

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: It was an honor doing battle with you, good Sir.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What the... So polite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha! So, been busy losing while we were away, Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker?

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: I don't see it that way. Unless the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King is ready to give up now, he hasn't lost to me yet.

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: In battle, and in life, it's normal to hit setbacks every once in a while. But a setback only turns into a failure if you make the decision to stop trying.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Word! Heck yeah! I ain't about to admit defeat yet!

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: Still, there's nothing to be gained from constantly making excuses. Don't put all your energy into talking garbage — spend it on fighting a little harder instead.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oof, burn...

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Oni King, this brand of enemy doesn't seem to be your area of expertise. I advise you send in another of your generals and observe the duel in detail.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Watching others do battle is also a crucial part of a warrior's training. Some skills, one learns by doing. Others, one learns through observation.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Good point, Grandmaster! And good timing, compadre! Oni King's Right Hand, I'm handing the fight over to you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, finally it's your turn! Make it count, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
response.text: #So I'm going head-to-head with the legendary {NICKNAME}? Guess I'd better look sharp...

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: Nicely done. You beat me.

dialogues.speaker: No-Frills Instant Kill
dialogues.text: #I'd go as far as to say that it's an honor to lose against {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahhh, so that's how you do it! I never would've thought of that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! When you're up against a cunning enemy, you gotta get creative.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When your tactics fail, you have to change your point of view. In our journeys far and wide, we often have to think on our feet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clinging to old methods can never solve the problem, no matter how hard you try!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I think Shinobu said something like that once, too. I guess there's something to it after all...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But I'll mull it over some other time. Right now, my focus is on the task at hand — more beetle-fighting!
